stimulus_text: Staff must lock the door and silence personal devices during lockdown.
Provide a visual alarm equivalent for occupants who cannot hear the auditory alert.
Verify by timed walkthrough that wheelchair users can reach the secure area within three minutes.
Conduct a full-building lockdown drill under realistic timing and record whether supports were usable.
Revise the evacuation procedure using findings from the annual accessible-egress drill review.
Students with personalised emergency plans must have an assigned adult escort for evacuation.
Occupants shall remain silent during lockdown.
Lock classroom doors from the inside and keep them closed until responders release the room.
Because the primary alert is auditory, provide a visual equivalent in every classroom.
Annex lists disability-designated teaching establishments for planning coordination.
Threat-assessment teams shall document disability-related false-positive safeguards.
Schools must appoint a security lead (Section 2.1).
Maintain a personal emergency evacuation plan (PEEP) for each pupil who requires assisted egress.
Function-based planning should address communication and transportation needs without diagnostic labels.
